The licence is as Commons records it. Identified as this saint because: Russian Lives of the Saints (1903-1911), July volume, plate for the 28th, captioned «Прохор, Никанор, Тимон и Пармен» - Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon and Parmenas. 28 July is the joint commemoration of those four of the seven deacons of Acts, and Parmenas is named in the plate's own caption; the folder's saint is that apostle and deacon. This is the canonical four-named commemoration icon, not a generic company of saints.
